title: feat(metadata-protocol): a metadata write's advisories and refusals come back in the caller's language (#32656, 1/2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXuamRUC67fx2TTYrFfyuSH)_

Part of #32656 (PR 1 of 2; the follow-up PR #33290 closes it).

## Maintainer quick read

A metadata write's advisories, and the issues of its 422 refusal, now carry `userMessage` written in the caller's language: the request's language, else the workspace default, else English (ruling C on #32440). `rule`, `message`, `hint`, `path` and `where` are unchanged. A rule with no user sentence carries no `userMessage`, as before.

## What changes

- **spec (minor):** `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema` and `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema` gain optional, server-stated `userTextLocales` (array, max 2, ladder order); the doors build these requests member by member, so a wire body never sets it (the `client` precedent). `PublishPackageDraftsRequestSchema` is the batch door's body parser, so it is unchanged: that door hands the locales to `publishPackageDrafts` directly, and a body `userTextLocales` is not read (pinned). `ExecutionContextSchema` gains optional `workspaceLocale`: the workspace default on its own, because `locale` folds the request locale and the workspace default into one value and the ladder needs both.
- **core:** `assembleExecutionContext*` fills `workspaceLocale` from the entry localization (never on a guest envelope). New helper `userTextLocalesOf(ctx)` returns `[locale, workspaceLocale]`, absent/empty values dropped.
- **metadata-protocol:** `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` composes `userMessage` per issue with `findingUserMessage(finding, userTextLocales)` (#32790's catalog). `userTextLocales` is threaded from save, single-item publish, and the package publish promotion into the gate (pass-through only; checked: E1's open PR #33251 touches none of these files).
- **rest / runtime doors:** `PUT /meta/:type/:name`, `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish`, the dispatcher's `/meta` save and the `packages` domain's publish-drafts state `userTextLocalesOf(executionContext)`.

## Why

Ruling C on #32440 (tracking #32654): the producer of a finding composes its user-facing sentence in the request locale, falling back to the workspace default and then `en`, and every client renders it as received. #32790 shipped the catalog and the `userMessage` member (layer 1); its acceptance note 7 left this layer: compose it at the door that knows both locales.

## Verification

- New `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-save-user-text-locale.test.ts`, on both `/meta` save doors (runtime dispatcher and `RestServer`) over a real protocol and SQLite store: the stated locales are read off the execution context (`['zh-CN','de']`, and `[]` with none); a zh-CN request gets the `security-private-no-readscope` advisory in Simplified Chinese while `rule`/`message`/`hint` equal the en answer; an unsupported request locale (`tlh`) falls back to the workspace default, then to `en`. 6/6.
- `protocol-publish-drafts-advisories.test.ts`: the package publish hands the stated locales to the gate for every promoted draft, and none when unstated.
- `assemble-execution-context.test.ts`: the frozen parity pins subtract `workspaceLocale` and assert it positively (present exactly when an authenticated principal's localization names one); new pins for the request-locale-wins / workspace-default-kept split, the guest envelope, and `userTextLocalesOf`.
- Exact pins updated for the new server-stated members: `http-dispatcher.test.ts`, `packages-publish-drafts-request-conformance.test.ts` (also: a body `userTextLocales` is not read), `rest-exec-ctx-principal-kind.test.ts`, `rest-server-meta-door-closed-sets.test.ts`, `rest-server-meta-member-selector.test.ts`.
- Local: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` full suite 22843 passed; `@objectstack/core` security 1394 passed; spec api+kernel 3546 passed; test-source alias gate clean; spec `check:generated`, `check:liveness`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:strictness-ledger`, ADR-0087 registration, changeset checks green.

Not in this PR (follow-up #33290 on #32656): refusal sentences written outside the authoring rules (the packaged permission-set lock's static English, and the permission middleware's denials, which today read only the folded `locale`) move onto the same ladder.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach what a metadata author writes; `userTextLocales` and `workspaceLocale` are stated by the server from the caller's request and workspace, never authored or sent by a client, so no taught sentence moves. The generated reference pages are regenerated.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
